name: Osprey Reef
description: An isolated Coral Sea atoll with sheer walls and reliable shark encounters at North Horn. Usually reached on liveaboards from Cairns.

name: Cod Hole
description: A shallow ribbon-reef site known for large, curious potato cod that approach divers closely.

name: Navy Pier
description: Pilings at Exmouth crowded with nudibranchs, wobbegongs and grey nurse sharks. Dives are timed to the tide.

name: Great Blue Hole
description: A circular marine sinkhole with stalactites hanging from a ledge. A short, deep dive that needs careful gas planning.

name: Half Moon Caye Wall
description: Sand flats with garden eels drop to a coral wall with swim-throughs and turtles.

name: Baron Gautsch
description: An Austro-Hungarian steamer sunk by a mine in 1914, lying upright off Rovinj and covered in soft growth.

name: Blue Grotto of Bisevo
description: Sea caves and walls off the island of Bisevo, with light shafts in the shallows at midday.

name: Darwin's Arch
description: Strong currents bring schools of hammerheads and seasonal whale sharks. For experienced divers on liveaboards only.

name: Gordon Rocks
description: A submerged crater near Santa Cruz with hammerheads, turtles and washing-machine currents.

name: Blue Hole
description: A famous sinkhole beside the shore, often combined with the Bells entry. The arch below recreational limits has a serious safety record, so stay within your training.

name: Lighthouse Reef
description: An easy shore entry in town with coral gardens, popular for training and relaxed second dives.

name: Canyon
description: A narrow crack in the reef with glassfish and a dim swim through the canyon floor.

name: Abu Ramada
description: A drift along a reef wall off Hurghada, known for large schools of snapper and goatfish in summer.

name: Elphinstone Reef
description: An offshore plateau with oceanic whitetips in season, steep walls and strong currents.

name: SS Thistlegorm
description: A British armed merchant ship sunk in 1941, upright on sand. Its holds still carry motorcycles, trucks and rifles.

name: Shark and Yolanda Reef
description: A classic Ras Mohammed drift between two reefs, ending among the scattered cargo of the Yolanda.

name: Elephant Cave
description: A flooded cave near Chania where fossil elephant remains were found. Shallow but an overhead environment, so guides and training are essential.

name: Nea Kameni Reef
description: Dark volcanic rock inside the caldera, with lava formations and small marine life.

name: Silfra Fissure
description: A crack between the North American and Eurasian plates filled with glacial water at about 2 °C and exceptional visibility.

name: USAT Liberty
description: A cargo ship wreck reached from the beach at Tulamben, covered in coral and full of fish.

name: Crystal Bay
description: A Nusa Penida site famous for seasonal mola mola, with cold upwellings and down-currents.

name: Batu Bolong
description: A pinnacle in the Komodo strait with dense fish life and strong currents around its sides.

name: Cape Kri
description: A point in the Dampier Strait known for one of the highest fish counts recorded on a single dive.

name: Secca del Papa
description: A granite pinnacle off Tavolara with barracuda, grouper and colourful gorgonians.

name: Grotta dei Gamberi
description: A cave and wall at Ustica, a marine reserve, where shrimps gather in the dark inner chamber.

name: Barracuda Point
description: Tornadoes of chevron barracuda, turtles and reef sharks on a drift around a pelagic island. Permits are limited.

name: Maaya Thila
description: A small underwater pinnacle with whitetip reef sharks and very good night diving.

name: Banana Reef
description: A curved reef with caves, overhangs and heavy schools of fish; one of the first dive sites opened in the Maldives.

name: Blue Hole Gozo
description: A shore-entry rock pool that opens through an arch to the sea at Dwejra. Check the sea state before entering.

name: MV Um El Faroud
description: A 110-metre tanker scuttled near Wied iz-Zurrieq in 1998, with large open spaces and a split hull.

name: Palancar Reef
description: Coral towers and swim-throughs on a gentle drift off Cozumel, with warm clear water.

name: Dos Ojos
description: A cenote with light beams through clear fresh water. This is a guided cavern dive with a continuous line.

name: Roca Partida
description: A remote rock in the open Pacific, with sharks, tuna and giant mantas, reached on long liveaboard trips.

name: Blue Corner
description: A plateau where divers hook in to watch sharks and schooling fish in strong current.

name: German Channel
description: A channel between lagoon and open sea with manta cleaning stations on the incoming tide.

name: Monad Shoal
description: A sunken island where thresher sharks visit cleaning stations around dawn.

name: Akitsushima
description: A Japanese seaplane tender sunk in 1944 in Coron Bay. Its crane and cracked hull suit trained wreck divers.

name: Shark Airport
description: A sandy slope and wall at a UNESCO atoll, with sleeping whitetips. The park opens only in the spring season.

name: Princess Alice Bank
description: An offshore seamount south of Pico where large groups of mobula rays gather in summer. A long boat ride on open ocean.

name: Garajau Marine Reserve
description: A protected area near Funchal with resident dusky grouper and rocky volcanic slopes.

name: Aliwal Shoal Cathedral
description: A rocky amphitheatre where ragged-tooth sharks gather in season. Boats launch through the surf.

name: Two Mile Reef
description: A wide subtropical reef with many fish species, popular for training at Sodwana Bay.

name: El Bajon
description: An underwater volcanic cone off El Hierro with big schools, rays and fast changes in current.

name: Medes Islands
description: A Mediterranean reserve with tunnels, large grouper and red coral close to L'Estartit.

name: Chumphon Pinnacle
description: Granite pinnacles covered in anemones, with batfish and occasional whale sharks.

name: Richelieu Rock
description: A horseshoe pinnacle covered in purple soft coral, known for macro life and passing whale sharks.

name: Canyon Kas
description: A drop through a limestone canyon on the Lycian coast, close to wrecks and ancient amphora sites.

name: Kyiv Reservoir Training Point
description: A freshwater training area north of Kyiv with low visibility and cold water beneath a warm layer. Check current access rules before planning a dive.

name: Odesa Bay Wrecks
description: Black Sea wrecks in the Odesa area with mussels and limited visibility. Check current access and safety restrictions before planning a dive.

name: USS Spiegel Grove
description: A 155-metre landing ship sunk as an artificial reef off Key Largo, with current on most days.

name: Manta Night Dive Kona
description: Divers kneel on the sand at night while lights draw plankton and feeding manta rays.
